qa_pair.question: In Claude Code 2.1.306, a hook handler of type "script" is rejected. What is the exact error text the program prints for it? Give only the text inside the backticks of the docs row, with the type name in double quotes.
A user sets statusLine.refreshInterval to 0 in settings. According to the docs, what is the effective re-run interval in milliseconds?
Status line scripts re-run after a new assistant message or a permission mode change. How many milliseconds is that trigger debounced by, per the docs?
For the hook events that have a lowered default timeout of 30 seconds (command, http, and mcp_tool handlers), how many events are listed?
Which plugin path variable, usable in hook commands and MCP stdio args, changes when the plugin updates, so a plugin must not write state there?
Using the settings.json JSON Schema for this version, how many values does the enum of permissions.defaultMode allow?
The docs say the word "manual" is accepted as an alias for one permission mode. Which mode name is it an alias of?
Which environment variable moves the whole .claude folder, and cannot be set from project or local settings files?
In which folder does Claude Code keep clones of added marketplaces? Give the path pattern with the placeholder as written in the docs.
Using the settings.json JSON Schema for this version, how many top-level properties does it define?

Use the tools with source "platform" (the Claude API docs, not the Claude Code docs). The Claude API Versions page says every API request must send a header with which value for the current version? Give the header value only.
Use the tools with source "platform". On the Claude API Errors page, which HTTP status code goes with the error type request_too_large?
Use the tools with source "platform". On the Claude API Errors page, which error type goes with HTTP status 529?
Use the tools with source "platform". On the prompt caching page, up to how many cache breakpoints can you define in one request?
Use the tools with source "platform". On the prompt caching page, how many blocks does the lookback window cover when the system checks for a matching cache entry?
Use the tools with source "platform": first search_docs the platform docs for the Claude API rate limits page, then read_page it. Which algorithm does the API use for rate limiting?
The server exposes four tools. Name them, sorted alphabetically and separated by comma and space.
Which four values does the source argument of search_docs, read_page and list_pages accept? Give them in the order of the tool schema, separated by comma and space.
These Claude Code docs are the default source. A call that passes source "docs" is rejected as an unknown value. Which source value selects these docs when you name it?
A call to search_docs with max_results fails because that argument does not exist. Which argument name caps the number of hits, and what is its largest value? Answer as name and number.
Use read_page on route extend/mod-api/events/hooks with section_heading "Budgets". What is HookBudget.lingerMs, the time a hook may keep running after an abort, in milliseconds?
Use read_page on route extend/mod-api/events/hooks with section_heading "Failure Behavior". What happens when a tool.call hook fails?
Use read_page on route extend/mod-api/calls/turn-prompt with section_heading "Members". Which mode does $.prompt.fill use by default?
Use read_page on route configure/permissions/auto-mode with section_heading "How the Classifier Decides". Which rule list holds the security boundaries that user intent does not clear?
Use read_page on route how-it-works/request-and-cache with section_heading "Cache Lifetime". Which environment variable forces a five minute cache and wins over the other items?
Use read_page on route how-it-works/system-prompt with section_heading "Bare Mode". With --bare, how many tools does the request carry?
Use read_page on route prompts/defaults/default-lean with section_heading "Size". How many tools does that capture send?
Use read_page on route prompts/tools with section_heading "How to Override". Which environment variable limits the length of an MCP tool description?

Use read_page on route extend/mod-api/types/session with offset 0 and max_chars 1000. The example shows $.session.send. Which two fields does its result destructure? Answer as the two names, separated by comma and space.
Use read_page on route extend/mod-api/types/session with offset 1000 and max_chars 2000, the second window of the page. Which ContextWindowSource value means the model's own limit?
Use search_docs with query "circuit breaker" and limit 1. What is the route of the single hit?
Use search_docs with source "clawdipedia", query "PermissionDenied hook", and limit 2. What is the route of the first hit?
Use search_docs with source "code", query "status line refreshInterval", and limit 1. What is the route of the single hit on code.claude.com?
Use search_docs with source "anthropic", query "Responsible Scaling Policy", and limit 2. What is the route of the first hit on www.anthropic.com?
Use list_pages with section "how-it-works". Which route covers how Claude Code saves a session and where every file lives on disk?
Use list_pages with source "code" and section "Reference". Which route is the Tools reference page?
Use list_pages with source "anthropic" and section "legal". Which route is the Commercial Terms page?
Use get_schema with name "types" and property "HookBudget". What is the value of catchMs, the grace of a .catch handler, in milliseconds?
Use get_schema with name "status-line" and property "context_window.context_window_size". Which example number does its description give?
